scripts.check: pnpm run check:py && pnpm run check:web
scripts.check:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && uv run pytest
scripts.check:web: pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && uv run --env-file .env pytest -m integration
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --env-file .env alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
